children: Karyopharm Therapeutics secured a short-term forbearance from its lender, noteholder and royalty investor groups after missing a $15.8 million term-loan payment. The agreement pauses specified enforcement actions through the earlier of Oct. 15, 2026 or certain triggers, while default-rate interest of an additional 2% applies to the term loan and unpaid note interest. To compensate creditors and preserve liquidity, Karyopharm will pay $20.0 million of forbearance consideration in newly created 0% convertible perpetual preferred stock priced at $1,000 per share, convertible at $1.62, with a 19.99% issuance cap pending stockholder approval by Mar. 15, 2027. The arrangements are intended to provide time to advance the company’s myelofibrosis program and explore financings or strategic alternatives.
